about.title: My story, in short
about.p1: Hi! I'm Herimampionona Raphael Rajarison, a 21-year-old web developer with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from GSI Antaninarenina.
about.p2: A recent Computer Science graduate, I have hands-on web development experience gained through internships. Rigorous, autonomous and a strong team player, I adapt quickly to different technical environments and tools. Open to a variety of IT roles, I want to put my skills at the service of a team.
about.p3: If you'd like to know more, feel free to reach out, or just keep scrolling.
